title: A fixed choice gives a deterministic step
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, let $b$ be a choice bit, and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input. The one-step result from $c$ using choice $b$ is the same as the one-step result of the deterministic machine obtained by fixing $M$'s choice to $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes
A configuration $c$ on a fixed input
